bridges.name: Orientation-Closure Bridge (Topological Selection)

statement.informal: Orientation coherence conditions admissible knot-class selection but is not independently sufficient for closure stability.
statement.formal: -(i) conditions selection on T in the chain Delta -> R -> T -> A_adm -> delta_a

MODEL_D.name: Topological Selection Model
MODEL_D.description: Orientation is a selector/constraint on admissible closure topology, while stability arises from residue-conditioned topological admissibility (Principle 2.X).

hypotheses.H0: Orientation coherence has no independent effect on knot-class selection or admissible topology.
hypotheses.H1: Orientation coherence narrows the set of admissible knot-classes (T).

bridges.success_condition: Orientation coherence significantly narrows the distribution of observed knot-classes in admissible regimes.

failure_conditions.minimum: Knot-class distribution is identical regardless of orientation coherence.
failure_conditions.strong: Knot stability depends only on residue accumulation (R), with orientation providing no predictive shift in topological class.

statement.informal: Coherent orientation is induced by stabilized triadic closure of distinction-nodes.

MODEL_C_V2.name: Induced Alignment Model
MODEL_C_V2.description: Coherent orientation alignment emerges dynamically within persistent, stabilized triadic closures.

hypotheses.H0: Orientation coherence remains random regardless of triadic stability.
hypotheses.H1: Triadic stability induces orientation alignment (C_orient growth).

failure_conditions.minimum: Orientation coherence remains random under stable closures.
failure_conditions.strong: Orientation drift diverges regardless of triadic stability.

bridges.name: Orientation-Closure Bridge (Procedural Model)

statement.informal: Procedural orientating maintains the core invariants of the admissibility window.

MODEL_C.name: Independent Aspect Model
MODEL_C.description: Orientation (procedure) and closure (structural invariant) are decoupled signatures of a common underlying recursive residue field (K).

bridges.reason_for_rewrite: PD_CG_V2 justified procedure-level re-audit, but PD_CG_V2R did not support promotion of the _R-conditioned improvement route. The active governed baseline is now bare preserved distinction pending direct baseline-vs-qualifier testing.
